valores.label: Steel bars drilled and grouted into the slope ('over 4,600')

fonte: Caltrans District 5, "Highway 1 to Reopen Today at Regent's Slide" (January 14, 2026)
texto_para_tela: 4,600+ STEEL BARS · UP TO 60 FT · CALTRANS | REOPENED JAN 14, 2026 · NOON
nota: Caltrans: 'Over 4,600 steel bars, up to 60 feet long, were drilled and grouted into the slopes in a 10-by-10-foot grid'. A voz diz 'thousands': vale.
conversoes: 14/01 → 30/03/2026 = 75 dias, ~2,5 meses: 'months ahead of its target date' vale
licenca: fato e citação curta de órgão do Estado da Califórnia, com atribuição (uso editorial), recriados no visual do canal

pedidos.pedido: L5: 'Over 4,600 steel bars, up to 60 feet long, were drilled and grouted into the slopes' (R175); 'starting at noon on Wednesday, January 14, months earlier than the estimated reopening date of March 30' (R176); a nota da Caltrans é de 14/01/2026 (M20; R177).
